transcript.text: Good morning Rushil Bhatia. Here is your daily news for Friday, November 13. transcript.title: Top headlines
transcript.text: First, the stories leading the news this morning. Nvidia loses $500 billion amid 'spy' scandal; Huang slips to 13th on Forbes rich list. Nvidia faced a sharp decline in stock value following CEO Jensen Huang's surprising resignation, igniting fears about its leadership stability. In just one week, the company's market value plummeted by nearly $500 billion, with shares now down around 30 percent from October's peak. Consequently, AI ecosystem firms suffered losses, while competitors thrived. Investors are now bracing for Nvidia's upcoming quarterly report, eager to assess revenue and future projections. Has 'sanatani' Akhilesh finally walked out of 'Mullah' Mulayam's shadows?. Akhilesh Yadav plans to visit the Ram Janmabhoomi Temple in Ayodhya on December 12, 2026. He is also constructing the Kedareshwar temple and has installed a Krishna statue in Saifai. Akhilesh's political strategy balances Hindu outreach while engaging with the Muslim community through Iftar events. His approach aims to reshape the Samajwadi Party's image amid changing political dynamics. 'Road full of potholes': Back from Italy, woman accused in Thar crash breaks silence. Geeta Sachan, a 24-year-old woman, allegedly ran over LIC agent Santosh Singh Chauhan in Kanpur. The incident occurred as she swerved to avoid pedestrians, resulting in a fatal collision with Chauhan's scooter. As she panicked, Sachan claims she pressed the accelerator instead of the brake. Her lawyer stated that conditions such as potholes contributed to this unfortunate accident. Hugging Face CEO calls Jensen Huang's Nvidia exit 'sad', vows to keep fighting for AI. Clement Delangue, the CEO of Hugging Face, voiced his worries regarding Jensen Huang's exit from Nvidia. With Hugging Face's $12.9 billion acquisition by Nvidia approaching, regulatory pressures have increased. Delangue reaffirmed his commitment to open-source AI, a domain Nvidia significantly supported under Huang's leadership. As the acquisition is projected to finalize in early 2027, concerns about the future of such commitments loom large. Sandpaper row: Pat Cummins opens up on legal action against Usman Khawaja. Australia captain Pat Cummins responded to Usman Khawaja's claims about the 2018 ball-tampering scandal during a press conference. Cummins stated that Khawaja's allegations were serious and irresponsible, affecting players and their families. He chose not to pursue legal action despite being advised that some claims might be defamatory. Cricket Australia has decided not to reopen the investigation into the scandal according to Cummins. 3 different voter numbers: Rajasthan SSR draft counts 11 lakh more voters than SIR list. Rajasthan's latest draft electoral roll, published Thursday under the Special Summary Revision (SSR) 2027, has produced a fresh numbers puzzle. Microsoft begins restoring services after global outage hits 365 suite. Microsoft has begun restoring services following a major global outage that affected its Microsoft 365 applications. Almost 130,000 users globally reported problems with accessing services like Outlook, Teams, and OneDrive. The company identified elevated load on servers as a key issue and is working to rectify the situation. Users experienced difficulties in sending emails and accessing other applications across the Microsoft 365 platform. 'I love Gujarati food': Sonia Gandhi on her favourite Indian dishes. During a heartwarming chat with Priyanka Gandhi, Sonia Gandhi reminisced about her journey with Indian cuisine. Initially overwhelmed by the array of spices, Sonia gradually found joy in staple dishes like dal chawal and flavorful kebabs. This culinary evolution not only reflects her adaptation but also underscores the importance of food in connecting her to her late husband, Rajiv Gandhi, making dal chawal a comforting reminder of home. Trump Jr. defends Russell Brand after rape conviction, questions sentence. Donald Trump Jr. has defended Russell Brand following his rape and sexual assault convictions, questioning the comedian's 10-year-and-six-month prison sentence. Referring to Brand's marriage to Katy Perry, Trump Jr. remarked that no one seemed to consider him a rapist then. Gina Hinojosa says she can work with Elon Musk and his companies, but has a condition. Gina Hinojosa, Texas' newly elected governor, has stated that collaboration with Elon Musk must prioritize Texans' interests. She previously criticized the outgoing governor for proposals involving public land transactions near SpaceX operations. Following her election, she requested a pause on these state land decisions during the transition period. Elon Musk asserted that Texas has provided a favorable business environment in contrast to California. Florida woman who lived quietly for 23 years leaves $4 million fortune to charity. An 88-year-old Florida woman who lived quietly in a rented apartment for more than two decades left behind a $4 million estate, with two local organisations set to receive $2 million each. Fourth ODI: Rohit and Kishan drop New Zealand opener on consecutive deliveries. The two chances came off the fifth and sixth balls of the second over, bowled by Auqib Nabi.

transcript.title: Across India
transcript.text: Turning to the big national stories. India makes gains against TB, deaths down 38 percent since 2015: Centre. India's estimated TB deaths declined by 38 percent between 2015 and 2025, signaling significant progress in controlling the disease. The treatment success rate for drug-susceptible TB reached 94 percent , supported by innovative diagnostic methods and comprehensive patient care. The ongoing TB Mukt Bharat Abhiyaan effectively identified nearly 15 lakh asymptomatic TB cases throughout the campaign.
